notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Mark your calendars – Early Access is set to begin in [b]July 2025![/b]

In Firearms Factory, you must take control of your firearms factory to fuel the war effort. Design weapons with precision, manufacture them without mercy, and ensure their arrival on the frontline—failure is not an option.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mxYTiZU.gifhttps://i.imgur.com/mxYTiZU.gif[/img]
The Early Access version offers:

[list]
[*] A campaign titled Discovery of Fission. You will manage a German firearms factory during World War II, and more importantly, you will play a story in which you are responsible for the development of the German Atom Bomb Project.

[*] You will produce firearms for critical occupations, secure vital materials, and transport them to the factory to assemble the Bomb.
[/list]
[h2]Partnership![/h2]

As a 21-year-old game developer, I am excited to announce that we ([url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/bark%C4%B1n-anayurt-0711471b7/]me[/url] :D) partnered with [url=https://gamedev.ist/en/]GameDev.ist[/url] to publish Triplex Terminal's first-ever game, Firearms Factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41857377/a15755959d6c4b9dcff49bc0b262ff6567bfedf7.jpg[/img]

To do not forget about the Release Date, make sure you wishlist Firearms Factory!
Sincerely,

Barkın Anayurt
